metadata.datasource: From W. I. Kisner, 'A Higher Speed Color Print Film', Journal of the SMPTE 71(10), 1962, pp. 779-781, Figs. 1-3: EASTMAN Color Print Film, Type 5385 (35mm) / 7385 (16mm), scanned; each figure levelled, calibrated on its own tick marks and its solid curves traced with 5382's dashed ones taken out (kodak_1962_sheets.py). Dyes: the paper's three dye spectral densities, 400-700 nm, as drawn: they add up to its neutral's within 0.012 from 400 to 680 nm, and the neutral is kept as the midscale neutral; put on agx's dye-amount scale, a unit of each reading in its own channel what a unit of Kodak 2383's does. Base: the curves' own D-min, R 0.083 G 0.121 B 0.146, as fog and stain, the dyes in the amounts that read it. Characteristic curves: integral density, taken as Status A; their exposure axis carries no numbered ticks and is read at the scale of their density, one decade drawn as long as one density unit, as Kodak draws them (its 1968 paper on 5254 marks its axis so, to 3%); the paper moved each curve along the axis 'to illustrate the curve shape', so where each lies is not used. Past the plot's top (R 3.56 G 3.56 B 3.57, still rising) each continues as agx's curve model fitted to what is plotted, to D-max R 4.47 G 4.70 B 5.02. Mid-grey, as on every agx print stock: log H 0 in each layer is where it forms its share of a neutral grey of 18.4% luminance under agx's xenon projector (K75P), Status A R 0.78 G 0.78 B 0.78. Spectral sensitivities: the paper's shapes, on the scale it labels for 5385, none beyond them (the red layer's as its two strokes, blue and red); each layer's level from that one scale, taken where its curve reaches D-min + 1.0, the density Kodak plots a print film's sensitivity at (R +0.12, G +0.13, B +0.13 decades from its mid-grey). Printed with agx's lamp, Kodak Vision3 250D prints neutral at M 30, Y 70 (on 2383 at agx's M 51, Y 54); all three levels moved together by +0.222 decades to collect as much of agx's printer lamp (TH-KG3) as 2383 does, each through its own filtration for Vision3 250D. Printing lamp TH-KG3 and projector K75P as agx's 2383.
